tickets.subject: Quote draft left off the materials
tickets.description:
The assistant drafted a quote for a boiler swap and left off half the line items. Copper pipe and fittings were missing. Call me on 604-555-0142 or email priya.raman@harbourplumbing.example.

Thanks,
Priya Raman

tickets.subject: Reminder went to a customer who already paid
tickets.description: Your invoice chaser emailed my customer a reminder even though they already paid by card ending 4242 last week. Very embarrassing. My name is Tom Okafor.

tickets.description: Third quote this month where the draft is missing line items for labour. Card on file is 4111 1111 1111 1111 if you need to refund the month.

tickets.subject: Accounting export tax code wrong
tickets.description: The accounting export puts the wrong tax code on every labour line. Our bookkeeper has to fix it by hand each month.
